narrative.text:
The upstream head matches the planned base, and the task branch is reset to it with a clean tree. I’ll check whether moving the setting into `startupSettings` preserves existing behavior, then add tests in the existing files and run the red, mutation, and final gates.Both baseline suites pass: 584 tests on Node 22.23.3 and 584 on Node 24.22.1.

I’ll retain the getter: it currently rereads the environment during delivery, while moving it into `startupSettings` would freeze the value at startup. The fork’s “clamp” also preserves the fallback to 50 for out-of-range values; I’ll keep that behavior. `abc` currently resolves to 50 and will continue to do so.The zero-limit test fails on the unchanged code and passes with the fix. Removing only the new guard also makes it fail, even with zero still accepted by the getter; the mutant has been restored.

The single local commit is `d5a84bc`. Final clean-tree gates are running now, including both full suites and typecheck/build on both Node versions.
